description: This file implements a module for the Lighttpd web server to support the Apache JServ Protocol version 1.3 (AJP13). It defines functions for encoding and decoding AJP13 protocol packets, managing connections, parsing headers, and integrating with Lighttpd's plugin framework to handle requests via AJP13 communication with backend servers like Tomcat. It includes configuration handling, protocol framing, request creation, and response parsing functionalities.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges specific configuration values for the AJP13 module, updating plugin configuration based on provided config plugin value.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges plugin configuration by iterating through a list of configuration plugin values.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Creates a local copy of global plugin configuration and applies per-request configuration overrides based on conditions.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_set_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default configuration for the AJP13 plugin, reading configuration directives, setting default values, and performing validation.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint32_t ajp13_dec_uint16(const uint8_t * const x)
methods.description: Decodes a 2-byte unsigned integer from a byte array in network order.

methods.name: void ajp13_enc_uint16_nc(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 2-byte unsigned integer into a byte array in network order without bounds checking.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_uint16(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 2-byte unsigned integer into a buffer, ensuring it does not exceed maximum packet size.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_byte(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a single byte into a buffer, ensuring it does not exceed maximum packet size.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_string(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const char * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Encodes a string into a buffer with length prefix, handling empty string encoding as special case.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_stdin_append(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Splits request body into AJP13 packets and appends them to the outbound queue.

methods.name: void ajp13_stdin_append_n(handler_ctx * const hctx,const uint32_t n)
methods.description: Appends a request body chunk of specified size to the outbound queue with proper framing.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint8_t ajp13_method_byte(const http_method_t m)
methods.description: Maps HTTP method enum to AJP13 method byte code.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_request_headers(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes HTTP request headers into AJP13 packet format, handling common headers and custom headers.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attribute(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const buffer * const b,uint8_t code)
methods.description: Encodes an attribute key-value pair into AJP13 attribute format.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attributes(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes various HTTP request attributes into AJP13 attribute format within a packet.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_server_name(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes the server name or address into AJP13 format for inclusion in the request packet.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_create_env(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Creates AJP13 environment data for the backend request, encoding request headers, method, URI, and other details.

methods.name: int ajp13_expand_headers(buffer * const b,handler_ctx * const hctx,uint32_t plen)
methods.description: Parses AJP13 headers packet, decoding status line and headers into an internal buffer.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t ajp13_recv_0(const request_st * const r,const handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Handles end-of-request or unexpected socket closure scenarios during protocol parsing.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse_loop(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Main loop for parsing incoming AJP13 response packets, including headers, body chunks, and control messages.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse(request_st * const r,struct http_response_opts_t * const opts,buffer * const b,size_t n)
methods.description: Handles incoming data, appending it to internal buffers, and processes AJP13 packets.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_check_extension(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Checks if the request matches the AJP13 extension criteria and initializes protocol handling if so.

methods.name: int mod_ajp13_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registering all required callbacks and version information for AJP13 support.

methods.name: SETDEFAULTS_FUNC(mod_ajp13_set_defaults)
methods.description: unavailable
